purpose: Replay verification of continuation_from_prev (前页续入) against proofread pages as ground truth. For each first/final page N with predecessor N-1 in the dataset, replay the full add-time chain continuation_from_prev -> ocr_trim_continuation, using the PROOFREAD N-1 .gj as input (harsher than production: human edits introduce noise the algorithm must tolerate), and compare against GT = body text before the first head line of the proofread N .gj (the continuation the human placed on page N).
gt_extraction: line-based, NOT band-based: proofread head lines occupy their own line but not necessarily their own band (formats mixed across @313-328 and @331+ after 482b91b reformat); band-based extraction leaks the next entry's text into GT and contaminated 16 pages in an earlier run

metrics.cover: LCP(cont_n, gt_n)/len(gt_n) — placement start fidelity (library remainder should cover GT as prefix)
metrics.boundary_err: SM-last-block end mapping both sides — tail-boundary char distance between trim and GT; tolerant to scattered single-char variants (LCP-based metric is cut by 1-char divergence and once misreported cover 0.25 on the 中 chain whose 895 chars differ from the site by only 5)
metrics.scoring: 10=identical/end-aligned(range correct); 9/8/7=end diff 1-2/3-5/6-10; 5/3=11-20/20+; 1=missed(skip w/ GT); 2=host mismatch; correct skip=10

score_adjudication.page_335_script_score_2: host_ok heuristic false negative: host 丱 and breakpoint are both correct; the site's 丱 entry (116 chars) lacks the 44-char 按语 passage present on the scan ('〇按正韻上聲梗韻礦亦作卝…丱卝分而爲二非'), so GT prefix is not findable verbatim in library text. Adjudicated 5 = data ceiling, not an algorithm error. Avg after adjudication: 9.68.
